text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 95% of the expected vote counted in most counties (Yuma about 69%). Counts are unofficial until certified. Shares are two-party (Katie Hobbs vs. Andy Biggs); independent Risa Lombardo and write-ins are left out. Swing compares with the 2022 Governor county results (two-party share). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025, table co-est2025-pop-04).
